construction: Construction A - positioning LEVEL/decile-state book. For each of the four P0-mapped TD spot legs, compute the weekly net non-commercial positioning level normalized by open interest from the frozen CFTC disaggregated/TFF census bytes, map it to the USD-quoted pair basis (USDCAD sign-inverted per mapping_td_legs.json), bucket it into an expanding point-in-time decile state, and hold a fixed-weight spot book whose sign is a preregistered fade-of-crowding function of the decile state, rebalanced once per report cycle on the frozen 16:00-NY grid. Deciles 1-3 (uncrowded) are long states, deciles 8-10 (crowded) are short states, deciles 4-7 are flat; this is a decile-state book over 6 of 10 states with symmetric population, not a tail-extreme-only design (S2).
mechanism: State-conditioning only. The CFTC weekly census is a public, slowly-moving, low-frequency state variable summarizing how stretched leveraged currency-futures net positioning is relative to its own point-in-time history. CME currency-futures open interest is orders of magnitude below OTC G10 spot turnover, so the measured futures state cannot be a price-forcing quantity; no forced-liquidation, crowd-exit, or positioning-drives-price channel is claimed or implied, and crowding is not called sentiment or directional intent. The claim is strictly about conditional distributions: conditional on the decile state of normalized net positioning (pair basis), the conditional distribution of subsequent spot returns over one report cycle may differ from the unconditional distribution, after the mandatory G-D2-1 battery removes release-clock geometry (V1), day-of-week structure (V2), policy-rate-differential direction (V3), nominal rate level (V4), and price momentum/ancestry overlap (V5). Direction is preregistered as fade-of-crowding in the pair basis: states in which net positioning sits in its historically high deciles are preregistered to have conditional means of subsequent returns below the unconditional mean, and low-decile states above it. Any realized difference is consistent with the state proxying shared risk-premium or flow-information conditions; the cycle tests repeatability of the conditional pattern under the frozen representation, not a causal transmission channel.

formula.state_raw: raw_p(t) = (NC_Long_p(t) - NC_Short_p(t)) / OI_All_p(t), computed in exact Decimal per gate A4 (no binary-float coercion on census counts); NC_* = noncommercial long/short (All), OI_All = Open Interest (All), from the frozen disaggregated/TFF regime rows of the used futures code(s) for pair p at report date t.
formula.state_pair_basis: N_p(t) = s_p * raw_p(t), where s_p = +1 for GBPUSD, AUDUSD, NZDUSD (futures quotes the pair directly) and s_p = -1 for USDCAD (the CANADIAN DOLLAR futures contract quotes CAD/USD while the TD leg quotes USD/CAD; the single sign inversion absorbs the orientation so that every downstream sign maps 1:1 onto the TD leg as quoted).
formula.history: H_p(t) = { N_p(s) : s a report date with state defined, s <= t, s >= the 52nd prior report date of t within the scored span start 2006-06-13 }. Expanding, strictly point-in-time: only reports published before the decision instant enter.
formula.warmup: if |H_p(t)| < 53 (52 prior observations plus the current one), NO DECISION for pair p at t (book weight 0).
formula.percentile: u_p(t) = mean_rank(N_p(t) within ascending sort of H_p(t), average rank for ties) / |H_p(t)|, in (0, 1].
formula.position: sign_p(t) = -1 if d_p(t) >= 8; +1 if d_p(t) <= 3; 0 otherwise. Weight w_p(t) = sign_p(t) * (1/4). Book vector w(t) = {w_p(t)}_p; nominal gross = 0.25 * (number of active pairs) <= 1.0.
formula.pnl_identity_declaration: D2 measures per-pair returns r_p on the TD daily grid over [decision session, next decision session) as quoted (USDCAD leg as USD/CAD, no additional sign flip needed because the inversion lives entirely in s_p), portfolio return = sum_p w_p(t) * r_p, then applies the frozen forex band schedule plus the P-21 financing convention dual-book kernel (raw + financing-adjusted).

decision_rule: At each evidenced or convention-based release instant R_t (a2_availability.json basis: evidenced schedule dates inside the rolling window; 2025-10..2026-01 federal-appropriations republication window uses evidenced actual publish dates; all earlier scored-span report dates use the frozen convention model Friday 15:30 ET, federal holiday -> next business day, marked convention-based), the decision fires at D_t = the first 16:00-NY grid point strictly after R_t on the entitled TD daily grid. If D_t has no TD session, the decision is DROPPED, never shifted (X1(d)). At D_t each pair takes weight w_p(t) from the formula using only reports published before R_t. Entry at the D_t session value; the book holds unchanged until D_(t+1) (the next release's decision point) or the fold boundary, whichever comes first; force-flat at every fold boundary (F1/F2/F3 per a6_fold_freeze.json). Equal fixed weight 1/4 per pair, no vol targeting, no scaling by state magnitude; if D2 applies plan section 7 caps (gross 1.0, symbol 0.10) and the symbol cap binds, all weights scale proportionally so the sign identity is preserved.
lookback: Expanding point-in-time history per pair from scored_span_start 2006-06-13; minimum warmup 52 prior report dates (approximately one report year) before the first decision of a pair. No rolling re-estimation window, no fitted parameters, no per-fold recalibration; the decile is fully determined by prior published census rows.
holding_window: One report cycle: from D_t to D_(t+1) (typically 5 TD sessions, occasionally 3-8 with holiday-delayed releases or publication gaps). No intracycle rebalancing. Positions whose next decision point does not exist before the fold end are force-flat at the last session of the fold. Exits: at the exit grid point session; if that grid point has no TD session, exit at the next available TD session open strictly after it; if the fold boundary intervenes first, force-flat at the fold's last session.
universe: Exactly the four P0-mapped pairs from mapping_td_legs.json, joined to their entitled TD daily spot legs by the frozen market-name regex (no fuzzy joins): GBPUSD (s=+1, direct), USDCAD (s=-1, inverted: futures quotes CAD/USD, leg quotes USD/CAD), AUDUSD (s=+1, direct), NZDUSD (s=+1, direct). EUR, JPY, CHF, USD-index and all cross-rate contracts are out of scope per the mapping's out_of_scope_declared. No pair-level filters beyond entitlement; all four pairs always eligible subject to the missing-data rule.
turnover_estimate: One-way gross-unit turnover per decision date = sum_p |w_p(t) - w_p(t-1)|. Upper bound if all four pairs flip sign at full weight: 4 * 0.5 = 2.0 gross units/week (approx 104/yr). Expected: weekly decile persistence is high, and the active set is 6 of 10 states; assuming per-pair active-category (<=3, 4-7, >=8) transition probability of roughly 0.15-0.30 per week, expected one-way turnover is approximately 4 * 0.25 * (0.15..0.30) = 0.15-0.30 gross units/week, i.e. approximately 8-16 gross units/yr one-way, concentrated at decile-boundary crossings (3/4 and 7/8) and sign flips. Approximately 60% of decision dates carry nonzero gross; expected carry-to-rebalance weeks where the book is unchanged do not trade. Census decision-count basis: folds_decision_counts per pair F1=368(365-368), F2=366, F3=323, i.e. roughly 1055 report dates per pair over the scored span; minus the 52-report warmup (roughly the first 50 F1 decisions), gap weeks and dropped no-session grid points, expect roughly 990-1010 scored decisions per pair, of which roughly 60% land in active states. D2 measures exact turnover on the frozen representation; these figures are the proposal's pre-registered estimate only.
missing_data_rule: All rules inherited from the frozen X1 exclusion rule (a6_fold_freeze.json) plus construction-specific closures, deterministic, never repaired by inference: (1) Publication-gap week (no published report): no decision that cycle; the open book simply holds to the next decision point that actually exists (no census position is interpolated, carried forward or backfilled; state at the next decision is recomputed from the latest actually-published report only). (2) Decision grid point with no TD session: decision DROPPED, never shifted (X1(d)). (3) X1(b) revision conflicts: any (futures code, report_date) whose parsed rows conflict is excluded from books; the state for that report date is undefined, that report produces no decision, and the book force-flattens at that decision point, resuming at the next valid decision. (4) X1(c) value-correction Special Announcements: the named (code, report_date) rows are excluded and handled identically to (3); label-class/publication-delay items are annotate-and-keep with availability from evidenced publish dates (as of the freeze, no value-correction item touches a used code). (5) Warmup shortfall (< 53 history observations for a pair): no decision for that pair, weight 0. (6) A pair's census row missing required Decimal fields for a report date: no decision for that pair only; other pairs unaffected. (7) Missing TD session for an exit grid point: exit at next available TD session open, or force-flat at the fold's last session if the boundary intervenes first. (8) The TD-leg re-staging under the owner entitlement must pin fresh digests BEFORE any scored cell (p0_census not_run_declared); until then every scored-cell count here is prospective and binds to the frozen report-date grid regardless of re-staging.
falsifier: The proposal is killed by ANY of the following observed outcomes, measured by D2 on the frozen representation: (i) any mandatory G-D2-1 veto kills the anchor under plan section 5 bars - V1 bare release-clock book out-earns the anchor or its books distinctness is unmeasurable (P-20 fail-closed None); V2 generic day-of-week pooled |rho| > 0.20; V3 policy-rate-differential-direction shadow or V4 DGS10-level control not survived; V5 pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs the full same-plane shape inventory or the price-only momentum pool. (ii) S1 staleness sham: +1w/+2w delayed-state books reproduce the anchor (state content is a release-clock artifact; Q-11 INVALID-NULL distinction applies). (iii) S2 population: any fold x pair x active-state cell falls below the census-frozen Q-6 recent-window floor, making that decile-state book INVALID (not repairable). (iv) E1: the P-21 financing-inclusive worst-case round-trip cost ceiling measured at P2, including weekly rollover, exceeds the anchor's measured gross conditional spread, so no positive net edge can survive costs. (v) Direct directional falsification of the preregistered fade-of-crowding claim: the pooled cost-free conditional spread, defined as (mean hold return over short states d>=8) - (mean hold return over long states d<=3) per the formula's sign convention, is NEGATIVE in all three folds F1, F2 and F3 (every fold opposes the preregistered direction). Fold-wise or pooled mixed-sign outcomes are NOT auto-falsifying; they are reported and judged only through the (i)-(iv) battery, keeping D2's kill authority intact.
declared_controls: V1 CLOCK-BOOK: bare CoT release-clock book, same 16:00-NY grid, same hold geometry, same cost schedule; kill if it out-earns the anchor or books distinctness is unmeasurable (P-20 fail-closed None).

V2 GENERIC DAY-OF-WEEK: named explicit veto against the Friday-clustered CoT calendar (holiday-delayed weeks push Mon/Tue); kill bar is the numeric 0.20 bar - pooled |rho| > 0.20 on the frozen representation kills.
V3 POLICY-RATE-DIFFERENTIAL DIRECTION: shadow control of the differential-direction form; the DGS10-level control does not cover it (FXFV8-A4-P2 carry_unconditional 0.3831 template).
V4 DGS10 NOMINAL LEVEL: program-law level control (#14/#15).
V5 MOMENTUM + ANCESTRY: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 required vs the full same-plane shape inventory and a price-only momentum shadow pool.
S1 STALENESS SHAM: +1w/+2w delayed-state books must NOT reproduce the anchor; Q-11 INVALID-NULL distinction explicit.
S2 DECILE-STATE BOOKS ONLY: all measured books are decile-state books on the frozen census grid; tail-extreme-only designs forbidden; Q-6 recent-window population floors from the census bind.

E1 FINANCING-INCLUSIVE COST CEILING: P-21 worst-case round-trip ceiling at P2, financing-inclusive, weekly-hold rollover first-order, dual-book kernel (raw + financing-adjusted) required; no claim may rely on gross or pre-financing performance.
representation_identity: The exact P-12 grid representation D2 measures on: the frozen 16:00-NY daily representation - decisions at the first 16:00-NY grid point strictly after each evidenced or convention-based release instant (a2_availability.json basis; 2025-10..2026-01 republication window on evidenced actual publish dates; earlier windows convention-based Friday 15:30 ET / holiday next business day, marked), on the entitled TD daily spot grids of the four mapped pairs; USDCAD measured as the quoted USD/CAD leg with the single census-side state sign inversion s=-1; entry/exit at grid-session values, hold one report cycle, force-flat at F1/F2/F3 fold boundaries with folds assigned by as-of report_date per a6_fold_freeze.json; X1(d) no-session decisions dropped never shifted; no interpolation, no carry-forward, no grid shifting; scored span 2006-06-13..2026-09-08, disaggregated/TFF regime only (legacy era census-only, excluded per X1(a)).
outcome_blindness_declaration: This lane computed no returns, PnL, PF, Sharpe, drawdown or correlations and read no price files; every numeric figure above is a census count (folds_decision_counts, coverage_census.json) or a declared construction parameter. D2 owns all measurement and all kill decisions under the battery.
